transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Uh… I guess things have been getting away from me. Since I moved into this busted-up room, I’ve been snapping at people and staying up dealing with leaks or the heat not working. Then I’m dragging myself into work late and messing up things I normally know how to do.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or activities?
I don’t know… not really sure. I haven’t been paying much attention to that kind of thing lately.
Have you been feeling down or sad most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I mean… I’ve been stressed, yeah. But sad most of the day every day? I don’t know. I haven’t really thought about it like that.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy most days, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I don’t know… I mean, I’m tired sometimes, but I haven’t really kept track if it’s most days or anything.
Have you had trouble thinking clearly, focusing, or making decisions lately?

Yeah… kind of. Since I moved into this busted-up room, I’m up dealing with leaks or the heat and then I’m late to work, messing up things I usually handle fine. I’ve been snapping at people too. It’s just been hard to keep my head straight.
Have you had days where you felt down or sad most of the time, and if so, has that happened often over the past couple of weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had some rough days, yeah, but I don’t know if I’d say sad most of the time or that it’s been that often.
Have you found that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or activities, don’t interest you anymore, even a little?
I don’t really know. I haven’t thought about it like that… I still do stuff sometimes, just maybe not paying much attention to whether I’m enjoying it.
Can you think of any activity or hobby that you used to enjoy, even a little, that you don’t seem to care about anymore?
I’m not sure… nothing specific comes to mind. I mean, I haven’t really been paying attention to that kind of thing.
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where you felt down or sad most of the time, and if so, how often has that happened?
I don’t know… I mean, I’ve had a few low days, but I haven’t really kept track. I couldn’t say it was most of the day or how many times exactly.
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where you felt down or sad most of the time, and if so, how often has that happened?
Yeah… like I said, I’ve had some days where I felt pretty low, but I don’t really know if it was “most of the time.” I haven’t been counting it or anything.
Looking back over the past couple of weeks, would you say there have been days when you didn’t take pleasure in things you usually enjoy, even things you used to look forward to?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought about it like that. Maybe a little, but I couldn’t say for sure.
Looking back, would you say there have been times in the last few weeks when you couldn’t find any enjoyment in things you used to like, even a little?
I’m not sure… I mean, maybe some things haven’t felt the same, but I wouldn’t say I couldn’t enjoy anything at all. I just haven’t really paid attention to it like that.
Looking back, would you say there were days in the past two weeks when you couldn’t feel any pleasure or interest in things you used to care about, even things you normally enjoy doing?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I couldn’t feel anything. Maybe I’ve been less into stuff, but I haven’t really been keeping track like that.
Looking back, would you say there were several days in the past two weeks when you truly couldn’t find any pleasure or interest in things you used to enjoy, even a little?
I don’t think I can really say that. I mean, I’ve been off, yeah, but “truly couldn’t find any pleasure”… I don’t know. I haven’t really noticed it like that.
Looking back, would you say there were several days in the past two weeks when you had no interest or pleasure in doing things you usually enjoy, even things that normally matter to you?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t put it like “no interest.” I’ve been kind of checked out, I guess, but I can’t really say it was several days like that.
Looking back, would you say that over the past two weeks there were several days when you felt down or sad most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had some low moments, I guess, but I don’t know if I’d say most of the day or nearly every day.
Looking back, would you say there were several days in the past two weeks when you truly felt no interest or pleasure in doing things you usually enjoy, even small things that normally matter to you?
I don’t know… I don’t think I’d say “truly no interest.” I’ve been off, but I haven’t really kept track of it like that.

Looking back, would you say that over the past two weeks there were several days when you felt little to no interest or pleasure in doing things you usually enjoy, even small things that normally matter to you?
I mean… maybe a little here and there, but I’m not sure I’d say several days. I still do stuff, just kind of… not as into it, I guess.

Looking back, would you say that over the past two weeks there were several days when you felt little to no interest or pleasure in doing things you usually enjoy, even small things that normally matter to you?
Yeah… I mean, like I said, I don’t really know. I’ve felt kind of off, but I wouldn’t say I’ve had no interest in everything or anything like that.
